title: Runner observability three-file proof
objective: Create a small typed metric dependency chain whose three independent File Jobs make concurrent Runner progress visible.
requirements: Metric records expose key, label, value, unit, and highlighted fields with the exact planned types.
formatMetric emits the metric label, a colon, its numeric value, and its unit with stable spacing.
summarizeMetrics preserves input order, includes only highlighted metrics, reports the highlighted count, and returns No highlighted metrics when none qualify.
Metric records expose key, label, value, unit, and highlighted fields with the exact planned types.

owns.name: Metric
owns.description: Describes one measured value and whether it belongs in the highlighted report.
owns.declaration: export interface Metric { key: string; label: string; value: number; unit: string; highlighted: boolean; }

context.purpose: Defines the metric vocabulary and output behavior.

skills.name: Minimal metric contract
skills.content: Export exactly the planned Metric interface. Keep every property required and add no runtime behavior or extra exports.

constraints: Do not add declarations beyond Metric.

files.task: Format one metric with stable punctuation and spacing.
requirements: formatMetric emits the metric label, a colon, its numeric value, and its unit with stable spacing.

owns.name: formatMetric
owns.description: Formats one metric label, numeric value, and unit for display.

context.purpose: Defines the exact metric label behavior.

skills.name: NodeNext metric formatter
skills.content: Use an import type for Metric and the exact NodeNext-relative module specifier supplied in the Agent Input. Return the label, colon, value, and unit without mutating the metric.

files.task: Compose the highlighted metric report from the shared formatter.
requirements: summarizeMetrics preserves input order, includes only highlighted metrics, reports the highlighted count, and returns No highlighted metrics when none qualify.

owns.name: summarizeMetrics
owns.description: Builds the ordered human-readable report of highlighted metrics.
owns.declaration: export function summarizeMetrics(metrics: readonly Metric[]): string;

context.purpose: Defines filtering, ordering, header, and empty behavior.

skills.name: Stable metric report
skills.content: Filter without sorting or mutating. For one highlighted metric use `1 highlighted metric`; otherwise use `{count} highlighted metrics`. Put each formatted metric on its own following line. Return exactly `No highlighted metrics` when the filtered list is empty.

constraints: Call formatMetric(metric) for each highlighted metric.
